text:
marie: Heads up — small rollout of FP8 on L40S + H100 started at 23:40 UTC, seeing weird tail latency spikes on H100 after ~40s of sustained traffic. baseline (int8) was stable.

jordan: can you paste the p50/p95/p99?

marie: p50 48ms, p95 220ms, p99 1.6s on H100 host pool. L40S p99 stays ~260ms. Throughput drops ~18% on H100 when spikes occur.

alex: logging from runtime shows kernel elections switching between te_fp8_matmul and te_fp8_fallback_int8 around the same timestamps. suspect kernel fallback thrashing.

marie: exact log snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T23:41:12Z] kernel_select: layer=attn_qk kernel=te_fp8_matmul score=0.82
[2026-03-18T23:41:12Z] kernel_select: layer=attn_qk kernel=fallback_int8 score=0.79 reason=stability_check
[2026-03-18T23:41:12Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.04 warmup=false active_batches=12
```

jordan: interesting — score delta small, so small perf jitter flips election. on H100 maybe occupancy or sync points differ. microbatching maybe causing fluctuations. what are batching params?

marie: batching config is max_batch_latency_ms=8, max_batch_tokens=1024, microbatch=4, continuous_batching=true. We did increase batch size for FP8 to amortize quant overhead.

sam: oncall chiming in — saw a deploybot note at rollout. perf-bot shows CPU->GPU transfer latency jumps correlated with NVLink % utilization.

perf-bot: auto-profile-report attached -> top kernel times (sampled): te_fp8_matmul 38% avg, te_fp8_scale 12%, nv_kv_copy 9%. Hot cache sequences show rapid small KV replays causing tiny memcpy bursts.

alex: hypothesis: FP8 path reduces compute time but exposes sensitivity to KV-copy microbursts, causing the kernel selector to flip when sampled latencies spike; fallback to int8 then causes longer compute, then flips back — a feedback loop.

jordan: can we add hysteresis to kernel election? e.g., require 3 consecutive samples > threshold before switching, or use EWMA on latency score. That would avoid flipping on single microburst.

marie: agree. quick patch idea: election.window = 3, election.ewma_alpha=0.2. Also limit fallback rate to 1/s per model-instance.

alex: also saw calibration diff lines earlier in traces: layer norms with fp8 calibration_scale drifted after 30s of long-context tokens. possible quant saturations causing extra ops. sample: `calib_scale[layer_11]=1.04 -> 1.19` when context > 1024.

jordan: that explains some stability checks firing. maybe adjust calibration per-sequence length or use hybrid calibration: use fp8 for matmuls but keep layernorm and softmax in fp16. That keeps numeric stability without full revert.

marie: running a canary with TE config: `transformer_engine.fp8_mode=matmul_only, fp8_calib_decay=0.99` on two H100 nodes now. will monitor for 10m.

sam: if that fixes p99 we can roll to remaining pool. if not, rollback plan B = revert H100 to int8 and keep L40S FP8 (since L40S behaved).

perf-bot: quick perf snapshot (canary, 2m): p50 46ms, p95 210ms, p99 270ms, kv_miss_rate 0.02, kernel-flips 0 -> 0 (over last 120s).

marie: promising. saving traces. action items: 1) add hysteresis/ewma to kernel selector (marie), 2) add per-layer fallback whitelist for layernorm/softmax (jordan), 3) telemetry: add kernel_flip_count metric to per-instance dashboard (alex), 4) schedule regression test covering long context + bursty KV (sam).

alex: noted. also logging note: include `batch_id` and `kv_seq_len` in kernel-select logs to correlate.

jordan: will prepare a small perf eval with FP8 vs INT8 vs hybrid for L40S/H100, varying microbatch 1..8 and context 128..2048. results to be posted in #eng-ml.

marie: thanks. if canary stays good i'll push election config and small rollout tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sam: leaving a short postmortem draft in incidents/ if we need to escalate.

perf-bot: report uploaded: /mnt/logs/profiles/2349991234/canary_snapshot_2026-03-18-2348.json

marie: closing thread for now, feel free to ping me if you see new spikes.
